# JHOOMWAVE

> JHOOMWAVE (jhoomwave.com) makes personalised songs with your name, in minutes. Birthday songs, wedding entry songs, kids songs and lullabies, couple songs, devotional bhajans, anniversary songs and company anthems, in Hindi, Hinglish, Punjabi and English. Free preview first; pay only if you love it. Based in India. Instagram: @jhoomwave.

## What you can order
- Name song (birthday or any occasion, the name is sung in the chorus): ₹99
- Wedding entry song with the couple's names (also dulha entry, dulhan entry): ₹299
- Varmala song ₹199, bidai song ₹299, sangeet song ₹499, Wedding Pack ₹1,999
- Kids: lori with the baby's name ₹99, bedtime story ₹99, 1st birthday ₹249, Kids Pack ₹249
- Couple / Valentine song ₹149, devotional bhajan or aarti with family names ₹199
- 25th / 50th anniversary songs from ₹299, family mashup song ₹499
- Fun announcements (airline, railway, cricket style) ₹29, ready songs ₹9
- Business: wedding planners, venues, DJs, companies, schools, shops; plans from ₹2,999/month

## How it works
1. Pick the moment and type the name(s) and a few details.
2. Hear a free preview.
3. Pay only if you love it (UPI, cards). The full song is usually ready in about 2 minutes.

## Honest facts
- Songs are sung by JHOOMWAVE Voices, our synthetic voices, on original lyrics written by JHOOMWAVE. No copied songs, no copied voices.
- Our own kids characters: Jhoomu (elephant), Mithi (parrot), Tappu (frog DJ), Sunny (sunflower).
